items.title: William Russell Interview, 1962-09-04
items.q: when Bunk came here in 1942, we went down to see Fats Pichon, Walter Pichon, who's probably a very nice guy

ctx.x: I'd like to know what your personal opinion of his personality was.

I'm like, I believe, with all the musicians, and most of the better ones, you'll hear some awful reports occasionally, some musicians will say, oh, he was terrible. For instance, when we went to try to get, when Bunk came here in 1942, we went down to see Fats Pichon, Walter Pichon, who's probably a very nice guy, and I was prejudiced against him because when Bunk went and asked him to record with him, he refused. I guess it was going to be a non-union date. The union, of course, meant nothing to Bunk and all. I…
He received you very ambly, though.
